source_scope: Round 47 sequential review of printed Chapters 882–891; cumulative item ledger is EVENT-SOURCE-ITEMS-v4.7.csv; fixed schedule unchanged.

confirmed_outcomes.event: Xiao kills Uriel; hidden achievement rewards include Light God's Blood x1, Divine Crystals x10, Light Godfire x1, 100000 reputation; Uproot reaches 100%.
Saint Eight survives the God-Slaying Arrow and is captured; Saints Twelve and Fourteen escape using one Church Emblem.
Uproot 90% and 100% rewards delivered: Light Spear skill book, Divine Power Shards x50, Light Godhead x1, selectable Legendary Relic Box x1.
Three existing Light Codex volumes and 300 Divine Power Shards produce one Complete Light Codex.
One Light God's Blood is consumed to finish the existing Storm Axe's first awakening; relic box selection results in Annihilation Blood for Berje.
Berje consumes Annihilation Blood and an existing Legendary Heart, reaching Legendary. Cracatoa's blood fusion is deferred.
Isabella binds Complete Light Codex; Fortune Goddess's Favor S-rank quest accepted at 0/3; coordinates and staged rewards are objectives/offers, not receipts. Dream mist recedes.

Dream Layer activity ends at Day 152 00:00; squad handovers to Cao Xing report Dream Shards x105232, Dream Shards x82942, and Dream Crystals x247. His aggregate inventory panel then shows 7,592,345 Dream Shards and 2,162 Dream Crystals. The crystals convert to 2,162,000 Dream Shards; no shop purchase is confirmed before chapter end.

non_receipts: Church offer of 300 Divine Power Shards and one Godfire for Uriel was rejected.
The 300 shards spent in codex fusion are a cost, not a reward.
Fortune quest rewards are unclaimed; its third-stage reward is unknown.
The Light Godhead is not fused; the Light Spear skill is not learned in this batch.
No dream activity reward total is attributed to an individual.
The final 3,000,000 Dream Shard prompt for three Legendary Hearts is not confirmed as accepted; do not record the items as purchased.

inventory_snapshot.source_note: Aggregate balances include prior holdings and current activity receipts; they are not additional acquisitions.

exchange_status.dream_shop_close: Day 153 06:00 (six hours after activity portal closes)
exchange_status.shown_prompt: Spend 3,000,000 Dream Shards for three Legendary Hearts
exchange_status.arithmetic_conflict: The displayed balances plus crystal conversion equal 9,754,345 Dream Shards; subtracting the stated 5,500,000 planned total leaves 4,254,345, not the stated 2,250,000. Preserve both source statements without correcting either.

item_details.panel: Light Godfire increases breakthrough success for Light-type Legendary beings; reduces success for other systems; can be purified into Pure Godfire by spending 2,000 divine-power points.

panel.rules: 30 divine power creates one spear; each additional 30 creates one more; maximum 20. Each spear has Causality Lock, ignores spatial barriers, evasion skills, and low-grade fate interference, and is stated to hit. Damage: (divine-power maximum + Spirit + Attack × 5,746%) piercing damage. Adds Holy Burn: 1% max HP per second for 10 seconds, doubled against divine beings. Against targets with darkness, curse, evil-god or similar negative status, damage increases 300%.

fusion_conditions: At least one of Light/Order/Purification divinities
Pass a divinity trial of faith, will and law comprehension
unfused_effects: Carrier is immune to all darkness and curse damage from beings below divine level
Taking the Godhead out of inventory continuously purifies surroundings
Activate to reduce all attributes of hostile beings below divine level by 20%; double effect against dark beings; 48-hour cooldown

item_details.panel: Selectable Legendary Relic Box; the source says it contains 108 choices. No random odds are given.

panel.selection: Relic: Annihilation Blood selected from the 108-choice box.
effects: Core material for a special-bloodline breakthrough to Legendary; can harmonize conflicting bloodlines and may awaken an extra ability.
Can be forcibly absorbed for a new bloodline: stated 25% activation chance and 75% chance of bursting to death.
panel.observed_use: Combined with an already-held Legendary Heart for Berje's successful breakthrough; the risky forced-absorption option is not used.

panel.core: Light Authority: all attributes +20000, Spirit +20000 additional, Light attack range +100%, Light damage +80%.
panel.retained: Six equipment effects, 41 Light skills across three chapters, and three Legendary effects (with slight number increases).

new_effects.name: Scripture Manifestation: Lightforged Armor
new_effects.rule: Creates armor for self or ally with durability equal to 30% of caster max HP, +30% armor and movement speed, regenerates 0.5% durability per second; reduces Light damage by 30%; non-Light hits apply Holy Burn (caster Attack ×21% each second for 5 sec, max 5 stacks); can detonate for remaining durability ×200% area damage and restore caster 20% HP. Only Legendary or higher beings can receive it.

new_effects.name: Trinity: Light Tide
new_effects.rule: Stage 1: 4×20 km flood, enemies move 80% slower and take Attack ×675% every 0.5 sec for 5 sec. Stage 2: up to 10 targeted 100×100 m beams, each Attack ×2588%. Stage 3: collapse explosion for Attack ×8725%; survivors take +100% Light damage for 1 hour.

panel.note: Three existing Codex volumes fuse after 300 Divine Power Shards are consumed; Isabella binds the output in Ch890.

item_details.panel: 50 Divine Power Shards received with the Uproot 90% stage reward.

mechanics_observations.result: Rewinds allies other than the distant Catastrophe Dragon to their states five seconds earlier, restoring health/status, resetting skills and equipment effects used in that span, and refreshing End-Time Redemption. The source does not establish a reusable item receipt in these chapters.

Legendary Heart and Annihilation Blood consumed; Berje becomes Legendary Dragon-Demon Emperor, with level cap 150, 1000% base-attribute increase, 200% attack range increase and +500 prosperity. New passive Dragon-Demon Body and active Three-Bloodline Fusion: Destruction Axe are unlocked; divine-power gauge opens.

details.passive: Dragon-Demon Body: damage from fire, dark, ice, water and curse reduced 40%; instant-death skill trigger chance forcibly reduced 20%. Below 60% HP: Norn blood adds 50% attack range and 30% healing received. Below 50% HP: Ice Dragon blood adds Iceburst to all attacks, splashing 45% damage to up to seven nearby enemies. Below 40% HP: Demon blood adds 35% Attack and true damage equal to Attack ×10% for five seconds.
details.active: Three-Bloodline Fusion: Destruction Axe costs 30 divine power, cooldown 24 hours; hit deals Attack ×4742% plus max HP ×20%, physical/ice/shadow mix; heals 30% of damage dealt, has 50% chance to Deep Freeze for three seconds, and critical hits add a 30%-damage Darkflame explosion. Can be used with weapon effects.

mechanics_observations.result: Berje estimates under 20% success for fusing Cracatoa's Crystal Dragon Blood at his current strength; at High Legendary or Mutated Overlord potential, success improves and a failed attempt causes severe backlash rather than immediate death. No fusion attempt occurs.

mechanics_observations.status: Accepted at 0/3; no stage reward claimed.
